title: Magnetic Lifting & Material Handling
painPoint: Magnetic lifting systems demand uncompromising safety margins, yet many operations suffer from demagnetization in high-temperature foundry environments where N42SH grades degrade beyond 150 degrees Celsius. Inconsistent magnetic flux density causes load slippage, endangering workers and damaging heavy steel plates. Engineers struggle with oversized, bulky lifters that cannot access narrow gaps between stacked materials. Custom geometries for irregularly shaped scrap and billets require prolonged design cycles. Without consistent Br and Hcj values across production batches, batch-to-batch magnetic performance varies unpredictably, undermining safety certifications and compliance with lifting equipment regulations.
youjiuSolution: YOUJIU delivers high-remanence N52 and N48 lifters engineered for sustained flux retention under dynamic load cycling, with 42SH and 35UH grades for foundry temperatures up to 180 degrees Celsius. We provide rapid custom tooling for specialized lifter profiles, from thin-plate lifters to multi-pole scrap configurations.
